problems.title: Express every factor as a power of 2
problems.question: Which power of 2 equals 2²·4⁴·8⁸?
problems.idea: Multiply exponents inside each power, then add them.

problems.title: Prime factors cancel a large quotient
problems.question: Evaluate 15⁸·75²/(125²·45⁵).

problems.title: Quadratic terms cancel
problems.question: Solve (2x-1)²+(3x+4)(4-3x)=(-x+3)²-6x².
problems.idea: Expand the squares and use a difference of squares.
steps: The left side becomes -5x²-4x+17 and the right -5x²-6x+9.

problems.title: A product of conjugate quadratics
problems.question: Prove a⁴+a²b²+b⁴=(a²-ab+b²)(a²+ab+b²).
problems.answer: The identity holds for all real a,b.

problems.title: Group a quartic into two quadratics
problems.question: Factor 4a⁴+8a³+4a-1.
steps: The a² terms cancel, leaving exactly the original polynomial.

problems.title: A symmetric cubic has a factor a+b
problems.question: Factor 2a³+3a²b+3ab²+2b³.
problems.idea: Separate two cubes from the remaining symmetric terms.
steps: Factor a+b and simplify the bracket: 2a²-2ab+2b²+3ab.

problems.title: A 30–60–90 triangle
problems.question: Triangle angles have ratio 1:2:3. Find longest side/shortest side.
problems.idea: Find the angles from their sum.
steps: The hypotenuse is twice the side opposite 30°.

problems.title: A diagonal satisfies two triangle inequalities
problems.question: AB=3,BC=5,CD=4,DA=10 in a quadrilateral. The diagonal AC is an integer. Find it.
problems.idea: Apply strict triangle inequalities to ABC and ACD.
steps: The common interval is (6,8), containing only integer 7.

problems.title: Points on bisectors have equal side distances
problems.question: ABC is right at B. AD and CE are bisectors. D,E are respectively 3 and 4 from hypotenuse AC. Find the sum of the two shortest sides of EDB.
formulas: A point on an angle bisector is equidistant from its two side lines.
steps: D lies on BC, so its distance to AB is DB; the A-bisector makes DB=3.
E lies on AB, so its distance to BC is EB; the C-bisector makes EB=4.
Triangle EDB is right at B, making DB and EB its two shorter sides. Their sum is 7.

problems.title: Use an exterior 30-degree angle
problems.question: In ABC, A=10°,C=130°. The B-bisector BL meets AC, and B is distance 2 from line AC. Find BL.
problems.idea: Find the angle that BL makes with line AC.
steps: The acute angle of BL to line AC is therefore 30°.
Let H be the perpendicular foot from B. In the right triangle with hypotenuse BL, BH=BLsin30°=BL/2.
